name: Streaming Tetrahedral Mesh Connectivity Compression
aliases: Predictive Geometry Compression for Tetrahedral Meshes
definition: A method for compressing the connectivity of tetrahedral meshes in a streaming fashion, using a delay buffer to reorder tetrahedra to maximize element sharing (faces, edges, vertices) between consecutive tetrahedra in the stream, thereby reducing the number of new vertices/edges/faces introduced per tetrahedron.
summary: Streaming Tetrahedral Mesh Connectivity Compression processes gigabyte-sized meshes in a streaming fashion with a small delay buffer, achieving high compression rates while using drastically less memory than in-core methods.
